note:
Round 2 for /pages/pdrn-research, section `key_findings`, block `f2`. Malcolm picked the A-family nbp_pro_01 frame off skingenetix-pdrn-shortlist.png and asked for two changes, in his words:

  1. 'in the first layer of skin - lets show the active effect slightly enlarging the small balls -
     and making them glow (not showing a pearl sphere)'
  2. 'in the second deeper layer of skin - show the active effect mending broken strands and making
     the strands thicker and making them glow (not showing pearl spheres)'

BOTH CHANGES REMOVE THE SAME DEVICE. R1 put a discrete PEARL BLOB at each arrival — a cupped receptor granule in the cell band, a rounded cell among the fibres. Malcolm wants the arrival to act on the TISSUE THAT IS ALREADY THERE instead of introducing a new object. So every pearl blob comes out of both layers and the response is carried by the existing granules and the existing strands. That is a better picture of the copy than r1 was: 'supplies nucleotides via the salvage pathway' is material being fed into structure, not a new body arriving.

CHANGE 1 — THE GRANULAR BAND. No blob, no cup, no seated ladder. Where a shaft lands, the small round granules already in the band are slightly LARGER, plumper and rounder than their neighbours and LIT FROM WITHIN, brightest at the point of arrival and easing back to ordinary size and ordinary dullness with distance. 'Slightly' is in the brief because a measured swatch overcorrects — the enlargement should read as the same granules doing better, never as different objects.

CHANGE 2 — THE FIBRE ZONE. No blob, no cell. Away from the light, some strands are THIN, and a few are INTERRUPTED BY SHORT GAPS. Where the light lands, those same strands run CONTINUOUS, THICKER and GLOWING, with fine filaments bridging what were gaps. One smooth spatial gradient across the block.

### The claims concern, stated once and then proceeded with

R1's brief carried 'nothing is broken, nothing is frayed' as a hard negative, and that was deliberate. `block-firming-peptide-approach.json` spells out why: a block shown broken and then mended is a before-and-after of the same tissue, which is a measured-result claim. This page's copy is hedged twice — 'what laboratory research describes', 'a pathway ASSOCIATED WITH' — and does not make that claim.

Malcolm has asked for mending, so mending is what this brief draws. The mitigation is in HOW: the break and the repair are ONE CONTINUOUS SPATIAL GRADIENT across a single block — thin and gapped far from the light, thick and whole near it — and never a staged sequence, a split frame, a paired panel or an arrow of time. That is the device this family already uses and defends ('a mechanism propagating through tissue'). Split screens, side-by-side comparison, before/after captions and any second panel stay negated by name. If the concern needs settling properly, that is a copy question for the page, not a rendering question.

WHAT ELSE IS FIXED, BECAUSE IT IS A FAULT IN THE PICKED FRAME AND NOT A NEW REQUEST. In nbp_pro_01 the ladders are drawn as COMBS — one rail with teeth sticking off it — rather than closed ladders. The r1 brief asked for two parallel rows joined by crossbars and this engine half-obeyed. Both rails are now spelled out as running the full length and the ends as closed. Nothing else about the composition changes.

PALETTE: the picked frame is the coolest and greyest of the four finalists, which the r1 brief did not ask for — it asked for warm peach-cream, matching the firming diagram Malcolm named as the target. The word WARM is therefore reinforced here. This is brief compliance, not a new instruction.

TWO ROUTES, RUN TOGETHER, BECAUSE NEITHER IS RELIABLE ALONE:
  edit-*  image-to-image from the chosen frame. Best chance of 'this exact picture, with those two changes'. Carries the known risk that an edit redraws more than it is asked to, and that a reference drags framing back toward itself.
  t2i-*   reference-free, the full scene described again with the changes built in. Loses the exact composition, keeps full control of the mechanism.
Both go to every supplier that can take them. FLUX.2 is EXCLUDED from this wave on evidence, not habit: on BOTH r1 concepts it returned a bare layered block with no spheres, no shafts and no arrival — it does not draw this family's delivery vocabulary at all. Luma ignores references in this runner, so it appears on the t2i slots only.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AT RENDER SIZE. Four checks: NO PEARL BLOBS anywhere in either layer, which is the whole point of the round; LADDERS CLOSED, two full rails, not combs; the granule enlargement reading as SLIGHT; and the fibre gradient reading as one continuous field rather than two halves.

slots.title: edit · the chosen frame with the pearl blobs replaced by responses in the tissue itself
slots.prompt:
Keep this illustration exactly as it is — the same camera square on to the cut face, the same block of skin filling the same part of the frame, the same layer order, the same clear glass spheres floating above in the same positions, the same slender shafts of warm white light descending from them, the same pale hazy background, the same soft glossy style. Change only what is described below, and warm the whole picture slightly so the tissue reads as a soft warm peach-cream rather than a cool grey-pink.

FIRST, REMOVE EVERY SMOOTH PEARL-WHITE BLOB THAT SITS INSIDE THE TISSUE. In the band of small round granules there must be no large egg-shaped pearl body and no cupped or dish-shaped object. Deep among the fibre bundles there must be no rounded pearl cell of any kind. Everywhere one of those blobs used to be, there is simply more of the layer it was sitting in — more granules in the granular band, more fibre bundles in the fibre zone — as though the blob had never been there.

SECOND, IN THE BAND OF SMALL ROUND GRANULES, the arriving light now acts on the granules themselves. Where each shaft of light reaches that band, the small round granules already there are SLIGHTLY LARGER than their neighbours — a little plumper and rounder, only a little — and they GLOW SOFTLY FROM WITHIN with a warm light. The effect is strongest right at the point the light arrives and eases back smoothly with distance, so that toward the sides of the block the granules are their ordinary smaller size and are not lit at all. The change between the two is gradual, with no line and no edge. They remain the same kind of small round granule throughout; they are not replaced by anything else.

THIRD, IN THE DEEP ZONE OF LONG FIBRE BUNDLES, the arriving light now acts on the fibres themselves. Toward the left and right sides of the block, away from any shaft, some of the bundles are THIN and slack, and a few of them are INTERRUPTED BY SHORT GAPS, so those strands do not run all the way across. Where a shaft of light reaches the fibre zone, those same strands are WHOLE AND CONTINUOUS, noticeably THICKER and fuller, and they GLOW SOFTLY FROM WITHIN; fine bright filaments bridge across where the gaps were, closing them, and the bundles there are denser and more numerous. Again the change from one state to the other is a smooth gradient across the block, brightest and thickest at the light and easing back with distance — never an abrupt division, never two halves, never a comparison.

FOURTH, INSIDE THE GLASS SPHERES, the small flat pearl ladders must be drawn properly: TWO PARALLEL ROWS OF PEARL BEADS, one row along the top and one along the bottom, BOTH RUNNING THE FULL LENGTH, joined between them by short fine crossbars, with the ends closed. They must not look like a comb, a fork or a rake with teeth along one side only. They stay flat and face-on, straight and level, never curled and never twisted. The spheres that hold loose scattered single beads keep their loose beads exactly as they are.

Nothing else changes. No object is added to the picture and none of the layers change place.

slots.title: t2i · the same scene described fresh, with both responses carried by the tissue
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background, everything in WARM soft peach-cream tones, never cool and never grey. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level with the middle of the block and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block is centred and does NOT reach the sides of the picture: a clear band of empty hazy air, about a tenth of the picture's width, is left open along the left edge and along the right edge, with more clear hazy air above it. The tissue is a soft warm peach-cream, pale and matte.

THE LAYERS SIT DIRECTLY ON ONE ANOTHER, IN CONTACT, one solid continuous slab. From top to bottom: a narrow band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; then, filling the middle, a deep zone of long thick glossy fibre bundles in a warm pearl ivory lying in loose parallel horizontal waves through a peach-cream ground; a second thin smooth peach plate; and at the bottom a deep cushion of large smooth glossy rounded lobules in a pearly cream-blush, packed in two rows. The whole block stands on a thin clear colourless glass plate.

FLOATING IN THE HAZY AIR ABOVE THE BLOCK ARE FIVE TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE GLASS, of slightly different sizes and at slightly different heights, holding two different things.

THREE OF THEM HOLD A SHORT FLAT LADDER OF PEARL BEADS: two parallel rows of beads, one along the top and one along the bottom, BOTH RUNNING THE FULL LENGTH, joined by six short fine crossbars between them, the ends closed, the whole thing lying flat and face-on like a tiny stepladder, straight and level, never curled and never twisted. It must not look like a comb or a rake with teeth along one side. From each of these three spheres a slender shaft of warm white light descends STRAIGHT DOWN, through the quilted surface and the cream film, and reaches the BAND OF SMALL ROUND GRANULES.

THERE IS NO SEPARATE PEARL BODY ANYWHERE INSIDE THE TISSUE. The arriving light acts on what is already there. Where each shaft meets the granular band, the small round granules already in that band are SLIGHTLY LARGER than their neighbours — a little plumper and rounder, only a little — and they GLOW SOFTLY FROM WITHIN with a warm light, brightest exactly where the light arrives and easing back smoothly with distance until, toward the sides of the block, the granules are their ordinary smaller size and unlit. The change is gradual, with no line and no edge, and they remain the same kind of small round granule throughout.

THE OTHER TWO SPHERES HOLD LOOSE SINGLE PEARL BEADS, unlinked and separate, a small drift of tiny individual seed pearls with no bars and no rows between them. From each of these a slender shaft of warm white light descends much FURTHER DOWN, past the granular band and DEEP INTO THE ZONE OF FIBRE BUNDLES — and again there is no pearl cell and no rounded body waiting there.

INSTEAD THE FIBRES THEMSELVES CARRY THE CHANGE. Toward the left and right sides of the block, away from any shaft, some of the bundles are THIN and slack and a few are INTERRUPTED BY SHORT GAPS, so those strands do not run all the way across. Where a shaft of light reaches the fibre zone, those same strands are WHOLE AND CONTINUOUS, noticeably THICKER and fuller, and GLOWING SOFTLY FROM WITHIN, with fine bright filaments bridging across where the gaps were and closing them, the bundles there denser and more numerous. The whole thing is ONE SMOOTH GRADIENT ACROSS A SINGLE BLOCK — thin and interrupted far from the light, thick and whole and lit at it — never an abrupt division, never two halves, never a comparison of one side against the other. Small bright sparkles drift in the lit zones.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, and warm throughout.
